notes: Contraction paired with history-replace-0015. The revision's edit is derived (the largest amphitheatre in Rome follows from three premises), so the contraction removes its main stored premise instead: 'The Colosseum is the largest amphitheatre in the world' (has_largest_amphitheatre is functional, with the world as the place). Cardinality question: the Arena of Nîmes, a small Roman amphitheatre no one names as the largest. Related near reads the premise the other way (via largest_amphitheatre_of); related far and the two 2-hop derived questions ask the Colosseum's city, opening year and completing emperor through the description 'the largest amphitheatre in the world', all facts stored about the Colosseum by name. The revision's Verona Arena facts are not used (they belonged to the new object); the Verona Arena only appears as an unrelated local question.
